UK markets on Thursday 14 May 2026:

FTSE index seen opening 0.3% higher on Thursday.

10-year UK gilt yield at 5.028%, down 4 basis points.

30-year UK gilt yield around 5.695%, down 6 basis points as of midday London time on 14 May.

Analyst commentary: risks foreseen as skewed towards higher gilt yields and weaker GBP amid political uncertainty.

Streeting resigned on Thursday, saying he no longer has confidence in Starmer and is widely expected to launch an imminent leadership bid.
